verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a sandbox, test, or demo environment isolated from production cap-table data. The MCP integration answers questions 'from your live Cap Table' and is read-only, which is a safety control on production data rather than sandbox isolation. Managing multiple companies under one login, or using the free plan, would only be a user-side workaround for creating a test company, not a documented sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
